name: system-load-stress-tester
title: System Load Stress Tester
description: A simulated concurrent traffic stress tester with virtual user (VU) slider and live latency benchmarking curve.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Concurrency Load Stress Simulation: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
